help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:102  Destination to open: one name, several names separated by commas
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:103  (`--destination a,b`), or `all` for every destination the config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:104  declares. Optional when the config makes the choice unambiguous: with

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:108  `--destination` always wins.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:109
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:110  Naming more than one destination serves **one** dashboard with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:111  reports merged row by row: a session held by several destinations is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:112  listed once, with a badge saying how many copies there are, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:113  counts are printed both ways (distinct sessions and raw copies). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:114  destinations are read in the order named, and where two copies of a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:115  session disagree the first one named supplies the row — so the order is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:116  a choice, not an accident, and the narration prints it back.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:172  creates the encrypted local repository and its masterkey), then the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:173  remote destination (which is written, connected to, and — for a host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:174  nobody has met before — left stopped until you have checked its key out
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:175  of band), then installs the per-destination scheduler when selected.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:177  The local first save runs two `run-once` passes and reads the result
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:178  back, so a first run archives once, then proves the second pass adds

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:371  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:372  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:373  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:374
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:375  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:376  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:378    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:379    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:380    is the only thing that catches it.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:562  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:563  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:565  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:604  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:605  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:606  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:607  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:612
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:613  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:616  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:617  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:618  In a separate metadata-only run, use `--cost` to estimate the payload
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  size before choosing a full-text mode. `--scan` reads those payloads;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:620  `--text` uses the local index and checks that it covers the selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:621  sessions before treating zero hits as a complete answer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:624  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:626  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:628  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:629  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:631  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:632
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:634  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:635  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:637  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  `--text` searches the local FTS5 trigram index (substring matching for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640  runs of at least three characters). A shorter query is refused, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  answered: the report says `matched=unknown` and the run exits `3`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  `--scan` reads selected conversations and matches them as plain text
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  instead; it answers short queries, at the cost of reading them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:644
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:647  destination and answered for every session with no match, `3` could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:648  finish — reading it, placing every session in time, or evaluating the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:649  query — so a zero proves nothing. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:657  Search indexed titles and user/assistant text with SQLite's trigram tokenizer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:660  Read selected sessions and perform a case-insensitive substring scan.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:663  Emit one JSON object on stdout. Metadata searches include separate
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:664  matched / not matched / could-not-be-placed groups; text searches
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:665  carry coverage, read failures and a `query_state` for the query.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:668  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:671  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:674  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:680  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:687  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:688
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:690  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:691  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:693  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:701  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:703
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:704  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:706  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:709
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:710  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:711  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:713
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:714  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:715  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:716
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:717  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:718  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:720  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:721  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:722  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:724  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:727  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:730  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:734  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:735  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:739  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:740  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:748  Write every stored shard. By default a run that byte-for-byte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:749  replays the session's complete preceding shard sequence is collapsed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:750  to its first copy, because that is what a re-seal leaves. The archive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:751  is never modified either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:754  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:755  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:758  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:761  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:775  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:779  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:780  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:781
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:782  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:783  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:784  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:787  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:788  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:790  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:791  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:792  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:793  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:794  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:795  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:798  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:801  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:802  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:804  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:806  Reads complete `deepseek-<sessionId>.json` exports from `--inbox`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:807  (skipping `.part` files), archives each as one record in a sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  shard under `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<id>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`, and retires
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:809  the source file to `<inbox>/consumed/`. Idempotent by content: the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  Inbox directory holding the ext exports.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  Read every scanner session returned by `status` into our own stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:829  Harness sources are opened read-only. File-backed JSONL sources use a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:830  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  under chat-stasher's own data directory, not under any harness directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  collected; 3 = PARTIAL — the pass ran, but at least one harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:836  recognised sessions this build cannot archive (the `not archivable`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:837  line), so what was written is real but incomplete; 1 = the pass failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838  (collect itself errored, or individual sources could not be read).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:851  Named destination from the config. Read state is kept per
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  Destination repository this pass collects *for*. Read state is kept
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  per destination, so a different value is a different debt set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  This command never renames a harness-owned path.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:865
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  Gated by `data/harness-registry-v1.json` (`seal_policy` + `seal_source`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  + the platform cell's `confidence`): only a harness whose policy is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  `rename`, with an evidence `seal_source` line **and** a `source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  confirmed` platform cell may be renamed. Everything else (Codex = fd-holder,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  opencode = sqlite, any unconfirmed harness) is refused with the active
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  file untouched — renaming an fd-holder silently drops its post-rename
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  data.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877  Path of a file already inside --stage to seal. Paths outside the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  stage are rejected and left untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:892  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:907  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  Repository path override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:929  Masterkey file override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  Concurrency cap override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:938  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:942  Report the packs one destination's backend holds that **no index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:943  names** — what a push killed between its packs and its index strands —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  and say what the next push would do about each. Deletes nothing; there
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945  is no mode in this build that deletes.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  Dry run is the only mode. `--apply` is refused with exit `3`, naming
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:948  what a safe delete would need and this build does not have: a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:949  repository-wide lock every client honors, a conditional delete carrying
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  an object version, and a trustworthy backend modification time to age
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  candidates by. "Unindexed" means no index file names the pack, not that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  the pack is unused — a retry can reuse one and write a snapshot that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  depends on it while it stays unindexed on disk — so the gap is real, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  a formality.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956  Every pack it reports is verified the way the adopting open verifies one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:957  before reusing it: the header must decrypt, every blob it declares must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:958  decrypt and hash to the id the header gives, and the pack's bytes must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:959  hash to the id it is stored under. A pack that fails any of those is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  reported **unknown** with the verifier's reason, never as empty and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961  never as zero, and its presence makes the whole survey incomplete.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  Reads only: nothing is written to the repository, to an index file or to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  a pack. The report carries the repository fingerprint, the backend
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  family, pack and byte totals, the unindexed packs by id prefix and size,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  what the next push would adopt, and any pack an index names that the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  backend does not list. It never carries a path, a host, a machine or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  account name, or any conversation text.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  Exit codes: 0 = the survey finished and read every pack; 1 = the survey
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  finished and found a contradiction (an index naming a pack the backend
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  does not have); 3 = it did not finish reading — a pack or an index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  could not be read, the backend was unreachable, or `--apply` was asked
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:974  for — so no absence in the output proves anything; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:976  Named destination from the config. Required unless `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:979  Check the destination and stop: no repository is opened and nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980  is deleted. This is what happens without the flag too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:983  Refused. Present so that asking to delete gets an answer that names
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984  what a safe delete would need, rather than an unknown-flag error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:987  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:988  Candidate packs carry their full id, for audit; the human report
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  prints a 12-character prefix.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:992  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:995  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:998  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1001  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1004  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1008  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1009  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1010
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1011  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1013  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1014  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1015
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1017  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1022
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1025
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1026  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1027  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1029  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1030  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1032  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1033  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1034  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1037  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1038  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1039  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1042  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1045  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1046  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1047  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1050  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1053  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1056  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1059  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1062  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1065  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1066  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1067  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1068  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1069  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1070  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1074  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1075
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1076  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1077  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1078  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1079  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1080  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1081
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1082  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1083  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1084  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1085  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1086  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1087
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1088  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1089  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1090  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1092  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1096  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1097
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1098  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1099  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1100  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1101  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1102  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1103  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1104
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1105  With `--rebuild --destination`, the index is rebuilt from the archive,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1106  which is all a machine whose stage is gone still needs: no source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1107  machine, and no copy of its stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1108
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1109  What that rebuild does depends on which partition is named and on
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1110  whether there is a stage to restore into, because a partition's index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1111  written by the machine that owns it (ADR-017):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1112
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1113  * **This machine's own partition, with a `--stage` directory** — every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1114    archived session is restored to a temporary child of it, the full
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1115    index is rebuilt and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1116    snapshots stay immutable; nothing is pushed until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1117    restore finish. A same-machine snapshot found before publication
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1118    restarts the rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1119  * **Any other machine, or any machine when there is no stage directory
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1120    to restore into** — the rebuild is **read-only**. That machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1121    archived sessions are read cumulatively across its snapshots and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1122    rows are written to a derived index in this machine's cache (the path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1123    is printed). The destination is not modified at all: no snapshot is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1124    appended and no path in the named machine's partition is written,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1125    because no record authorizes one machine to rewrite another's.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1126
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1127  Both modes are safe to re-run, and neither is resumable: each run starts
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1128  over. A read-only run needs the destination and the masterkey, and no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1129  `--stage` at all — which is how a machine whose stage is gone, this one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1130  included, still derives its index from the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1131
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1132  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1133  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1134  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1135  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1136  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1137
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1138  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1139  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1140  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1141  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1142  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1143  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1144  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1145  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1146
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1147  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1148  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1149  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1150  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1151  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1152  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1154  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1155  destination rebuild of **this** machine's own partition (temporary
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1156  restored shards are removed after the new snapshot is written).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1157  Omitted, or not a directory, the rebuild restores nothing and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1158  read-only for any machine, this one included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1161  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1162  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1163  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1166  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. The command has
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1167  always rebuilt rather than incrementally patched; this spelling is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1168  provided for repair workflows and makes that intent visible.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1171  Destination to rebuild from. Requires `--rebuild`; either this or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1172  `--repo` must be named. Appends the repaired snapshot when the named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1173  `--machine` is this machine's own partition and `--stage` is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1174  directory; otherwise the rebuild is read-only and the result goes to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1175  a derived local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1178  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1181  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1184  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1187  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1190  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1194  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1195
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1196  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1197  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1198  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1199  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1200  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1201
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1202  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1203  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1204  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1205  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1206
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1207  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1208  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1209  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1211  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1214  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1218  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1219
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1220  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1221  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1222  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1223  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1224  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1225  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1226
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1227  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1228  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1230  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1233  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1236  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1240  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1241  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1242
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1243  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1244  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1245  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1246  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1247  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1248  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1249  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1250  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1251  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1252  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1253
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1254  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1255  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1256  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1257
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1258  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1259  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1260  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1261  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1262  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1264  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1265  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1268  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1271  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1272  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1273  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1274  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1275  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1276  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1277  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1280  With `--json`, emit the aggregate summary variant instead of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1281  full document: totals, one record per machine and per source, and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1282  the last 30 local days' counts, with no per-session array. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1283  variant is named `"summary"` in the object.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1286  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1289  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1292  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1295  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1298  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1302  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1303
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1304  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1305  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1306  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1307  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1308  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1309  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1311  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1315  Build or inspect the per-destination local full-text index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1322  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1325  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1326
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1327  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1328  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1329  the next time a session is read.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1335  Destination to index. Required unless an explicit repository is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1338  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1341  Masterkey file override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1344  Concurrency cap override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1347  Backend option key=value, repeatable (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1350  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1357  Read changed sessions from the archive and update the local FTS index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1359  Validate and count indexed sessions without contacting the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1361  Delete this destination's marked local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1467  The parameters of the remote step, exactly as the caller supplied them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1468
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1469  Every field here is either a name or a location. **No field can carry a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1470  secret**, and that is the point of the shape rather than an accident of it:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1471  the two credential fields are the *names of environment variables*, which the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1472  wizard writes into the config as `env:NAME` and never resolves itself. So a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1473  secret cannot reach the config file as plaintext, and it cannot reach
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1474  `argv` — where it would be captured by the process list and by any log that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1475  echoes the command — because there is no flag that would accept one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1478  Which recipe to write.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1481  SFTP: `ssh://<host>:<port>`. S3: the service endpoint, e.g.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1482  `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1485  SFTP only: the ssh user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1488  SFTP only: the private key to authenticate with. Optional — leaving it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1489  out lets the backend use the ssh agent and its own default keys, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1490  a real configuration rather than a gap.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1493  S3 only: the bucket (or container) the repository lives in.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1496  S3 only: the region. R2 is single-region and names it `auto`; another
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1497  S3-compatible service names its own.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1500  Both kinds: the prefix inside the account/bucket that the repository
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1501  lives under. Optional, and omitted rather than defaulted: a prefix the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1502  user did not choose would put their archive somewhere they did not name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1505  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the access key
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1506  id. Not the key id itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1509  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the secret
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1510  access key. Not the secret.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1513  Declare that this host's key was checked out of band, which authorizes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1514  recording it in `~/.ssh/known_hosts`. A declaration, not a verification:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1515  nothing here, and nothing anywhere else, can check that the comparison
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1516  happened. Without it the wizard stops at an unknown host and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1517  nothing (ADR-039, rejected option E).
